scope: Focused source audit and independently executed132-scenario API journey; exact Figma and native screen acceptance remain separate.

findings.finding: Store directory lacked geographic projection and region filtering.
findings.status: Source fix independently verified by actual API scenarios

findings.finding: Published campaigns applied workspace-wide without a persisted selected-shop audience.
findings.status: Source fix independently verified by actual API scenarios

findings.finding: Merchant account summary lacked a date-based activity series and financial/category breakdown.
findings.status: Source fix independently verified by actual API scenarios

findings.finding: Priced submitted orders had no explicit merchant-consented product/quantity amendment path.
findings.status: Source fix independently verified by actual API scenarios

findings.finding: Initial amendment BeforeJson stored an ADMIN order projection containing private pricing provenance and exposed it to the merchant.
findings.status: Source fix independently verified by actual API scenarios

findings.finding: Support assignment accepted SALES advisers although SALES cannot open support threads.
findings.status: Source fix independently verified by actual API scenarios

findings.finding: Active recalled batches remained in catalogue/favorite availability, the inStock filter and orderable cart consent while details correctly excluded them. Reservation guards still rejected unsafe allocation.
findings.status: Source correction independently verified by actual API on the rebuilt assembly

findings.finding: A managed returned recalled batch accepted the same expiry day with a changed hour, producing a different full recall identity; the proper refused-return RESTOCK then succeeded.
findings.status: Source correction independently verified by actual API on the rebuilt assembly

limits: The132-scenario matrix is API business acceptance, not visual parity for every Figma screen.
Location cases submit test coordinates and verify consent/freshness; no physical GPS device acceptance is inferred.
Receipt cases exercise issued QR payload/challenge exchange at API level; no camera hardware acceptance is inferred.
Actual recorded in-app messages and payments are verified; external transport delivery and financial settlement are not inferred.
